items.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Effective Immediately
items.summary: On November 12, 2026, Nvidia announced that co-founder and long-time chief executive Jensen Huang has resigned from his leadership position and board seat effective immediately. The technology giant appointed Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress as interim CEO while initiating a search for a permanent successor.

items.headline: Massive Microsoft 365 Outage Disrupts Outlook and Teams Worldwide
items.summary: A major global outage disrupted Microsoft 365 services on November 12, leaving over 100,000 users worldwide unable to access Outlook, Teams, and Copilot. Microsoft reported that unexpected server unavailability caused the disruption and that engineers are actively working to restore full service.

items.headline: 2026 ATP Finals Draw Set as Top Seeds Zverev and Alcaraz Headline Groups in Turin
items.summary: On Thursday, officials finalized the group draw for the 2026 Nitto ATP Finals in Turin, placing top seeds Alexander Zverev and Carlos Alcaraz at the head of separate round-robin groups. The year-end men's tennis championship begins on November 15 at the Inalpi Arena, featuring the world's top eight singles players competing for the final title of the season.

items.headline: Lucasfilm and Disney Announce Global 50th Anniversary Celebration for Star Wars
items.summary: Lucasfilm and Disney announced a year-long global celebration for the 50th anniversary of Star Wars in 2027, headlined by a restored theatrical re-release of the original 1977 film on February 19, 2027. The milestone slate also includes a new Disney+ making-of documentary titled The Hero Awakens alongside upcoming theatrical and streaming releases.
